# TDrive v3.1.6

This release fixes the first-run "Choose your TDrive" lookup failing with
"dialog paging did not advance" for accounts that have an empty chat at the
end of a page of chats. This was a regression in v3.1.5. Bản phát hành này sửa
lỗi bước "Chọn TDrive của bạn" khi chạy lần đầu bị báo "dialog paging did not
advance" với các tài khoản có một chat trống ở cuối trang danh sách chat. Đây
là lỗi hồi quy trong v3.1.5.

## Highlights

- First run: "Choose your TDrive" no longer fails with "dialog paging did not
  advance" when the last chat on a page has no messages. This was a regression
  in v3.1.5.
- The chat walk now pages by the last chat that has a message, so an empty
  chat no longer makes Telegram return the first page again.
- A page with no messages at all ends that folder, and a warning is written to
  the backend log. Use Copy diagnostics to include it in a report.

## Known limits

- The fix is verified with integration tests against a mock Telegram server,
  not against the affected account.
- A folder that ends in more than 100 consecutive empty chats may not list the
  remaining empty chats.
- If the lookup still fails for you, please send the output of Copy
  diagnostics with your report.

## Internal

- New regression tests cover paging past empty dialogs in the mock Telegram
  suite.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.6-windows-amd64-setup.exe` | Installer. A portable `TDrive-v3.1.6-windows-amd64.zip` is also attached. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `TDrive-v3.1.6-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip and drag TDrive to Applications. |
| Linux (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.6-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it, then run it. Needs glibc 2.35 or newer. |
| Android 7.0 or newer (ARM64) | `TDrive-v3.1.6-android-arm64.apk` | Allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 16 or newer) | `TDrive-v3.1.6-ios-unsigned.ipa` | Not signed. Install with TrollStore, Sideloadly or AltStore. |
